hook_line: AI SLUMP SENDS INVESTORS TO CHINA AND INDIA

hook_stat.sub: Nifty 50 gain last week — its best week since 2021

stats.label: Net foreign buying of Indian shares through Wednesday
Gain in a Hong Kong gauge of mainland Chinese companies, its best week since March 2025

diaspora_bullets: Some investors see the AI selloff as a buying opportunity
Benchmarks in India and China had ranked among the world's worst-performing indexes this year through October
news_summary: The unwinding AI trade after the US midterms is pushing global investors toward out-of-favour Chinese and Indian stocks, Bloomberg reports, as India's Nifty 50 gained 8.6 percent last week, its best week since 2021.
payoff: The rotation is also reaching healthcare, consumer and domestically driven Asian companies.
